entries.rationale: Zero-iteration exit of private _simple_kmeans_1d(); exported production caller does not expose the iteration count and invokes the helper with its positive default.
Private _running_mean() short-window return; its production caller clamps the window to at least 3.
Private _peak_indices(peaks=None) guard; exported PPG callers normalize missing peaks before calling the helper.
Duplicate-key rejection follows aggregation on the identical participant-condition-time keys, which has already reduced each key to one row.
Matrix missingness guard is reached only after exported preparation enforces a complete unique two-condition participant-time grid.
Private _unique_name() target-absent return; production enters the helper only after confirming the target already conflicts with the same name set.
Private _match_count() short-input guard; its sole production caller first requires coarse-grained length >= m + 2, satisfying both helper calls.
Private SCR peak loop branch for an empty pre-peak slice is dominated by the candidate-index construction and loop bounds.
Path('') normalizes to '.', so the subsequent str(path) == '' guard cannot be true.
The n > 1 false path follows an earlier n < 4 return, so every execution reaching this branch necessarily has n >= 4.
Datetime values are deduplicated and sorted; after the earlier len(t) >= 2 condition, at least one positive finite interval necessarily exists.
Private kernel rejects a non-positive sampling interval, while the exported caller filters positive intervals and passes their positive median.
Private _fft_psd() n < 4 guard is dominated by the exported caller, which returns before invoking it whenever n < 8.
False branch after the final supported artifact_type alternative would require an unsupported type already rejected by earlier validation.
The BIDS wrapper's public exporter always returns a dict on success and raises on failure, so the non-dict continuation cannot occur through exported behavior.
Private event-standardization alternative requires event_label_col, but exported production callers never supply that private fourth argument.
Signal-activity plotting raises when plot_data is empty and max_groups is validated positive, so the later len(plot_data) false branch cannot be reached.
The public HRV feature extractor's fixed schema supplies mean_ibi_ms and does not supply mean_ibi_sec at this point, fixing the condition true.
Requested factor/random columns are validated before the loop and inferred columns are selected only from existing data columns, so c not in data is impossible.
